sequence_points.name: Religious Procession Scene
sequence_points.description: A painted scene depicting a group of figures in historical or religious attire, including individuals in robes and head coverings, set against a muted background with architectural elements. The composition suggests a ceremonial procession, with warm earth tones and soft lighting.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Earth Tones
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring a dynamic interplay of earthy browns, ochres, and muted reds, with visible brushstrokes and layered textures. The artwork is mounted on a wall, partially cropped at the edges, suggesting it is part of a larger exhibit.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Earth Tones
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring blended earthy tones of brown, ochre, and muted green, with textured brushwork suggesting organic forms. The artwork is mounted on a wall, partially cropped on the right side.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Vertical Elements
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring muted tones and geometric forms, mounted on a museum wall alongside other artworks. The composition includes soft gradients and minimalistic shapes, suggesting a modernist style.
